rules: The judge (judge_v4.py) reads THIS file from its own directory; no environment variable can substitute another contract. JUDGE_ELIGIBILITY only LOCATES receipts ({arm: {receipt, inputs}}); a caller-supplied gate/self_sha/profile that disagrees with this file makes the arm ineligible.

An arm is a CANDIDATE only if its receipt (a) names the arm's candidacy_gate, (b) was written by a gate source whose sha256 is in gates.<gate>.approved_source_sha256, (c) says PASS, (d) is bound to this arm (receipt.arm == arm), (e) hashes every registered input of the gate (v4_gate_common.REQUIRED_INPUTS) including the four judged book files of the arm (book_binding), each equal to the file the judge loaded.

v4_gate_common.require refuses a pinned gate source that is not in the approved list of a gate registered here (a locally edited gate that re-runs and writes a fresh receipt matches its own runtime sha but is NOT the reviewed program).

An empty approved_source_sha256 list means no program is approved for that gate: no receipt can satisfy it and no arm can be a candidate through it. BUNDLE_export (PROPOSED2) is filled with v4e_gate_export_v2.py: its gates.BUNDLE_export.approved_baseline block FREEZES the approved baseline identity (device / cost json / mask / live_pins / bundle_base / A0 books by sha, every device knob by value) and every threshold; the gate refuses env overrides of them, registers the shipped bundle's full closure + cost/mask/king/FEMAT files + the bound signal receipt as inputs, and re-derives the book content identities from the shipped arrays.

Gates not listed here and not registered in REQUIRED_INPUTS are ungoverned: they carry no input floor and no approved-source list, and they cannot confer candidacy because arms map only to gates listed here.

MEMBER_LIVENESS.rule: a symbol is a member of anchor E only if at least one REAL 5-minute bar exists in the 288 cache rows ending at E's row (rows (E−24h, E]); real = NOT a hole-filled cell AND log_qv FINITE (not NaN and not ±inf). The gate RE-DERIVES liveness from CACHE + HOLE_CELLS and checks the member sets the builders PRODUCED (king meta + DL targets) plus, at the export stage, the shipped bundle's symbols_live. PASS iff dead-but-member cells == 0 everywhere and no refusal.
MEMBER_LIVENESS.boundary: data liveness, not venue eligibility truth (a real bar with zero trades passes; a name halted less than 24 h ago still passes). It does not replace a venue tradability rule.
MEMBER_LIVENESS.refusals_are_not_skips: an unreadable member set, an anchor absent from the cache ts axis, a member index outside [0, N), a symbols axis that is not the cache's, channel 3 not named log_qv, hole cells off the cache, a ts axis not strictly increasing ⇒ PASS=false with the reason named
